chunks: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn informed me, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl ibn Darrāj, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

The minimum of what menstruation is, is three days. If she sees blood before ten days, then it is part of the first menstruation; and if she sees it after ten days, then it is from another forthcoming menstruation.

key_terms.الدَّمَ: blood; the blood seen by the woman
key_terms.الْحَيْضَةِ الْأُولَى: the first menstrual period; the original cycle to which later blood may still belong
key_terms.الْحَيْضُ: menstruation; the legally recognized menstrual state
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ: three days; the minimum duration stated for menstruation
key_terms.حَيْضَةٍ أُخْرَى مُسْتَقْبِلَةٍ: another forthcoming menstruation; a new menstrual period beginning after the ten-day interval
key_terms.عَشَرَةِ أَيَّامٍ: ten days; the interval used to distinguish one menstruation from another

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum duration of hayd, and when is later blood considered part of the same menstruation or a new one?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the minimum duration of menstruation and on how to classify blood seen in relation to a ten-day interval. It distinguishes between blood that remains connected to the first menstrual period and blood that is counted as a new menstrual period.
